data.case_title: Sick pay (Krankengeld) suspended for late reporting – Muster BKK
data.title: Ablehnung von Krankengeld ab 12.01.2026
data.summary: Muster BKK (statutory health insurer) informs David Muster that his sick pay (Krankengeld) claim is suspended because his incapacity to work was not reported within one week, citing § 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V. Sick pay will only be paid from 22.01.2026, the date the certificate arrived, instead of 12.01.2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer (Muster BKK) has decided that you will not receive sick pay for the period from 12.01.2026 to 21.01.2026 because your certificate of incapacity to work was reported too late; payments only start from 22.01.2026. If you disagree, you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK, either by letter or in person, by the deadline shown (calculated from when the letter is deemed received). If you miss it, the decision becomes final and you lose the right to challenge the missing days of pay. Since the amount involved may be significant, consider getting advice (e.g. from a Sozialverband or lawyer) before the deadline.

key_facts.label: Reason for suspension
key_facts.value: Late reporting of incapacity to work (more than one week)
key_facts.quote: Ihr Anspruch auf Krankengeld ruht, weil die Arbeitsunfähigkeit nicht innerhalb einer Woche gemeldet wurde (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V).

key_facts.label: Certificate received on
key_facts.quote: Die Bescheinigung ging am 22.01.2026 bei uns ein.

key_facts.label: Sick pay paid from
key_facts.quote: Krankengeld zahlen wir daher erst ab dem 22.01.2026.

items.title: File objection (Widerspruch) against the decision
items.action: Submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to Muster BKK, or have it recorded in person (zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK), if you disagree with the suspension of your sick pay.
items.consequence: If you do not object by the deadline shown, the decision becomes final and the withheld sick pay for the period before 22.01.2026 will not be paid.
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.

remedy.form_text: schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK
remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.

data.tax_note: Krankengeld received is tax-free but subject to the progression clause (Progressionsvorbehalt) and must be reported in the annual tax return (Anlage N or the corresponding form).
